name: Touhou In'yashou
source:
The protagonist is lost within the forest located in the mountains. While searching for an exit, he finds an old temple within it.

That is the world which has been sealed off from the real world, Gensokyo.

Appearing in front of the protagonist is the mysterious miko Reimu Hakurei.

The fate that ties the protagonist and Reimu will begin by satiating her within 3 days.

[from [url=http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Touhou_Inyashou]Touhou Wiki[/url]]
translation:
主人公在山中的森林里迷路了。在寻找出路的过程中，他在森林中发现了一座古老的寺庙。那里就是与现实世界隔绝的幻想乡。
出现在主人公面前的是神秘的巫女博丽灵梦。将主人公与灵梦联系在一起的命运将在3天内满足她而开始。

[来自[url=http://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Touhou_Inyashou]东方Wiki[/url]]
